title: Consolidating Laboratory Equipment Reservations
description: A shared university laboratory maintains a log of equipment reservation slots throughout the day. Due to cancellations and modifications, some reservation slots overlap. Write a function to merge all overlapping reservation periods so that researchers can view a clean, consolidated timetable.
input_format: A 2D array of integers where each inner array represents a reservation start and end time.
output_format: A 2D array of integers representing the merged and non-overlapping reservation slots.

examples.explanation: Intervals [1, 3] and [2, 6] overlap and are merged into [1, 6].
Intervals [1, 4] and [4, 5] touch at endpoint 4 and are considered overlapping, merging into [1, 5].
After sorting, all slots overlap and merge into a single continuous block from 0 to 5.
